Technology stocks were softer in recent trading, with the shares of tech companies in the S&P 500 losing 2.2% in value, while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was falling 0.9%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(-) Ericsson ( ERIC ) has given back the 1% gain it previously posted after mobile operator Tigo Senegal said it selected the communications equipment company to lead a nationwide digitalization and network modernization project for the west African telecom firm.
In other sector news:
(+) Quarterhill ( QTRH ) climbed 6% on Thursday after the networking equipment company said its Polaris Innovations indirect subsidiary licensed some of its patents to privately held Powerchip Technology. It also said its International Road Dynamics subsidiary received a $2.8 million contract to provide truck screening services at five locations in Arizona.
(-) Bilibili ( BILI ) was down fractionally this afternoon, reversing a nearly 5% gain after the online entertainment company announced a business collaboration agreement with the Alibaba Group's ( BABA ) Taobao Marketplace ecommerce unit.
